lead: Products and tools for looking after skin, hair, teeth and body: skincare, make-up, hair care, shaving, oral care, bath and hygiene, and comfort. Organised by body routine, with icon lines and grooming traditions at the enthusiast end and a short list of good buys elsewhere.
